newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF WOMEN'S WORLD CUP SLALOM WINNER.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF WOMEN'S WORLD CUP SLALOM WINNER.

text.p: Following is a brief profile of Deborah Compagnoni, winner of a women's World Cup slalom on Sunday:
World Cup wins: 8. Slalom: Semmering (96). Giant slalom: Tignes (93), Veysonnaz (93), Morzine (94), Haus (95), Narvik (96). Super-G - Morzine (92, 93)
Other feats: 1992 Olympic super-G gold medal, 1994 Olympic giant slalom gold medal, 1996 world championship giant slalom gold medal.

Compagnoni has overcome illness and serious injury to return to the ski racing elite. She left her national ski federation two years ago to train alone with personal coach Dino Pietrogiovanna. Will not compete in super-G this season, concentrating instead on the technical disciplines.
